verdict.rationale: Companies House is a government company register with a read-oriented REST API and online filing services. It does not host or run user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. The evidence on API versioning (resources held as 'version 0') concerns the vendor's own API contract, not user automation versioning, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
